messages:
cheng_release: Starting a pre-publish thread for tomorrow's SDK rollout. We plan a shadow/canary flow for both py and ts clients during the 10:00-11:00 PT change window. Primary goals: (1) pin strategy for legacy sync client deprecation, (2) release-note blurb + docs callouts, (3) rollback checklist. Will stagger py then ts.

maria_dev: Are py + ts going out in the same window? worried about simultaneous breaks for integrators.

sam_eng: Yes same window but staggered. Py canary at 10:00, evaluate for 10m, ts at 10:20. Full publish target 10:40 if green.

jess_prod: Sounds good. We should surface the deprecation timeline in the release notes and call out the migration snippet. Also add opt-in telemetry toggle note.

cheng_release: Decision items: pin examples to the last sync-compatible major, add a runtime deprecation warning in the SDK import path, and publish a 60-day deprecation notice. Rollback trigger: error rate spike >1.5% or P99 latency regression >2x baseline.

maria_dev: For pinning I propose updating examples and quickstarts to `redwood-sdk==1.8.*` and adding a CI check to prevent accidental import of unpinned examples.

sam_eng: Agree. We'll also add an explicit compat shim: `from redwood.compat import legacy_sync` that surfaces a warning and points to migration docs. If we need an emergency revert we will: `deploy rollback --artifact redwood-sdk==1.8.2` (ops playbook ready).

alex_doc: I'll draft the CHANGELOG deprecation paragraph and migration guide. Can someone paste the minimal migration snippet for the two-line change?

maria_dev: Sure — paste into thread:```python
# old
from redwood.sync import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))

# new
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
# if you must stay sync for now, use compat shim
from redwood.compat import legacy_sync
legacy_client = legacy_sync.wrap(client)
```

sam_eng: We'll also publish a canary tag for py wheels: `redwood-sdk==2.0.0rc1-canary1` and shadow traffic via ingress rules. TS will use npm dist-tag `canary`. Both will run telemetry and smoke across sample apps.

jess_prod: I'll update the public release notes and internal runbook. Adding a short blurb: "Deprecating legacy sync client in 60 days — migration guide + compat shim available. Examples pinned to 1.8.x for meantime."

deploy-bot: canary job queued: id=3421, target=py-canary, start=2025-06-12T17:00:00Z. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/3421 

cheng_release: Triage plan if canary fails: 1) promote revert tag; 2) yank canary artifacts and re-publish previous stable; 3) notify integrators with short postmortem. Ops will run step 2 command from playbook.

sam_eng: I'll be on call for the window (10:00-11:00 PT). Will monitor metrics and logs.

jess_prod: :thumbsup: I've got the release notes draft and internal announcement. Will add the compatibility FAQ.

deploy-bot: job 3421 started. status=running. test-suite: smoke-tests x5 started.

cheng_release: Great — final checklist: docs draft (alex_doc), examples pinned (maria_dev), compat shim + warning (sam_eng), release notes + announcement (jess_prod), canary run (deploy-bot). If anything else shows up before 09:30 PT ping here.

maria_dev: Adding CI gate to block unpinned examples in a follow-up PR now.

sam_eng: Noted. Will surface telemetry dashboard links after first 10m.

cheng_release: Thanks everyone — see you in the window.
